name: intel-gpu-telegraf
description: Docker container running telegraf and polling Intel GPU stats.

variables.name: telegraf_hostname
variables.description: Container Variable: This will set the hostname variable in telegraf.conf

variables.name: influx_url
variables.description: Container Variable: This will set the outputs.influxdb URL variable in telegraf.conf

variables.name: influx_db
variables.description: Container Variable: This will set the database variable in telegraf.conf

variables.name: influx_password
variables.description: Container Variable: This will set the database password variable in telegraf.conf

variables.name: influx_skip_db_creation
variables.description: Container Variable: This will set the skip_database_creation variable in telegraf.conf
